## [What ClarifyGo customers now have access to](https://www.subphonic.ai/oak-transition\#focus)

Subphonic Focus retains full Microsoft-certified compliance recording across Microsoft Teams, contact centre platforms
and traditional telephony. It also adds transcription and conversation intelligence to make recorded conversations
searchable, reviewable and analysable at scale.

### Core capability

- Microsoft-certified compliance recording for Teams and voice environments
- Secure, auditable archiving with configurable retention and access controls
- Intelligent transcription, accurate and automatically applied
- Conversation analytics across large call volumes
- Implementation and ongoing support from an experienced delivery team
